subject: pe
title: ATP-PC System
welcome_lead: First 10 seconds — phosphocreatine fuels explosive efforts.
meta_desc: A-Level PE adventure on ATP-PC system, anaerobic alactic energy.
final_note: ATP-PC delivers fastest, lasts shortest — sprint's first gear.

concepts.def: Adenosine triphosphate; energy currency of the cell.
Anaerobic alactic system; provides ATP for ~10 s.
Enzyme catalysing PCr + ADP → ATP + Cr.
Restored in ~3 min; depends on aerobic capacity.

walkthroughs.body_html: PCr → ATP is a single-step reaction. No mitochondria, no glycolysis — immediate energy.
Muscle PCr ~80 mmol kg⁻¹ supports ~5–10 s of maximal effort.
50% PCr restored in ~30 s; full restoration ~3 min. Aerobic capacity speeds the process.
